_arch_note: [FFN-LUT sweep S2b] SWEEP2 reallocation: NO decompress (inner_out=-1, eff_out=384), nap6, tph72. Drop decompress matmul, spend vBW on full-width table outputs. Base = exp_n_0084 (untied head, FFN CompressionMHL slot). SHORT-RUN schedule n_steps=3500 (same LR schedule across the whole sweep so runs are comparable). Standard LUT optimizer (AdamW, tables in nodecay wd=0), init noise 0.001. Everything else identical to exp_n_0084.
_mem_note: device_batch_size 48->24 (grad_accum 1->2) vs exp_n_0045: the untied head materializes the full [tokens,vocab] logits+grad buffer that the tied graph fused away, which OOM'd at bs48 (LUT dense-K [24576,2048,128]~24GB + logits pushed >79GB). Halving the micro-batch keeps effective batch 24,576 identical (grad accumulation is mathematically equivalent) — science unchanged, memory halved.
